summary: The Plane of Fear is Cazic‑Thule’s dominion, a realm where mortal terror manifests as physical reality. Nightmares become flesh, and dread consumes all who enter.
history: Formed when Cazic‑Thule claimed dominion over mortal fear.
Dread Maw became the labyrinth of living stone jaws.
Nightmare Pits amplify mortal nightmares until they manifest.
Fear Temple rose as Cazic‑Thule’s sanctum.
